metadata.description: Azure region for all demo resources
Admin username for the demo VM
Admin password for the demo VM
Your public IP address for NSG access (run: curl ifconfig.me)

variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config
# Installs Docker, pulls all demo DB images, starts Docker Compose
# Runs on first boot — takes ~5 minutes to complete

package_update: true
package_upgrade: false

packages:
  - docker.io
  - docker-compose-plugin
  - curl
  - jq

runcmd:
  # Enable and start Docker
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - usermod -aG docker demoadmin

  # Create app directory
  - mkdir -p /opt/demo-dbs
  - cd /opt/demo-dbs

  # Write docker-compose.yml
  - |
    cat > /opt/demo-dbs/docker-compose.yml << 'COMPOSE'
    version: "3.9"
    services:

      sqlserver:
        image: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2019-latest
        container_name: demo-sqlserver
        environment:
          - ACCEPT_EULA=Y
          - SA_PASSWORD=Demo@Password123
          - MSSQL_PID=Developer
        ports:
          - "1433:1433"
        volumes:
          - sqlserver-data:/var/opt/mssql
        restart: unless-stopped
        healthcheck:
          test: /opt/mssql-tools/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P "Demo@Password123" -Q "SELECT 1" || exit 1
          interval: 30s
          timeout: 10s
          retries: 5

      postgresql:
        image: postgres:14-alpine
        container_name: demo-postgresql
        environment:
          - POSTGRES_DB=demodb
          - POSTGRES_USER=demouser
          - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=Demo@Password123
        ports:
          - "5432:5432"
        volumes:
          - postgresql-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
          - /opt/demo-dbs/seed/postgresql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
        restart: unless-stopped
        healthcheck:
          test: pg_isready -U demouser -d demodb
          interval: 20s
          timeout: 5s
          retries: 5

      mysql:
        image: mysql:8.0
        container_name: demo-mysql
        environment:
          - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=Demo@Root123
          - MYSQL_DATABASE=demodb
          - MYSQL_USER=demouser
          - MYSQL_PASSWORD=Demo@Password123
        ports:
          - "3306:3306"
        volumes:
          - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
          - /opt/demo-dbs/seed/mysql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
        restart: unless-stopped
        healthcheck:
          test: mysqladmin ping -h localhost -u demouser -pDemo@Password123
          interval: 20s
          timeout: 5s
          retries: 5

      mariadb:
        image: mariadb:10.11
        container_name: demo-mariadb
        environment:
          - MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=Demo@Root123
          - MARIADB_DATABASE=demodb
          - MARIADB_USER=demouser
          - MARIADB_PASSWORD=Demo@Password123
        ports:
          - "3307:3306"
        volumes:
          - mariadb-data:/var/lib/mysql
          - /opt/demo-dbs/seed/mariadb:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
        restart: unless-stopped
        healthcheck:
          test: healthcheck.sh --su-mysql --connect --innodb_initialized
          interval: 20s
          timeout: 5s
          retries: 5

      mongodb:
        image: mongo:6.0
        container_name: demo-mongodb
        environment:
          - MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=demouser
          - MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=Demo@Password123
          - MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE=demodb
        ports:
          - "27017:27017"
        volumes:
          - mongodb-data:/data/db
          - /opt/demo-dbs/seed/mongodb:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
        restart: unless-stopped
        healthcheck:
          test: mongosh --quiet --eval "db.adminCommand('ping')" || exit 1
          interval: 30s
          timeout: 10s
          retries: 5

      cassandra:
        image: cassandra:4.1
        container_name: demo-cassandra
        environment:
          - CASSANDRA_CLUSTER_NAME=DemoCluster
          - CASSANDRA_DC=dc1
          - CASSANDRA_ENDPOINT_SNITCH=GossipingPropertyFileSnitch
        ports:
          - "9042:9042"
        volumes:
          - cassandra-data:/var/lib/cassandra
        restart: unless-stopped
        healthcheck:
          test: cqlsh -e "describe keyspaces" || exit 1
          interval: 60s
          timeout: 30s
          retries: 10
          start_period: 120s

    volumes:
      sqlserver-data:
      postgresql-data:
      mysql-data:
      mariadb-data:
      mongodb-data:
      cassandra-data:
    COMPOSE

  # Pull images (do this before starting to avoid timeout on start)
  - docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2019-latest
  - docker pull postgres:14-alpine
  - docker pull mysql:8.0
  - docker pull mariadb:10.11
  - docker pull mongo:6.0
  - docker pull cassandra:4.1

  # Start all containers
  - cd /opt/demo-dbs && docker compose up -d

  # Wait for SQL Server then create demo DB/tables
  - sleep 60
  - |
    docker exec demo-sqlserver /opt/mssql-tools/bin/sqlcmd \
      -S localhost -U sa -P "Demo@Password123" \
      -Q "CREATE DATABASE DemoDB; USE DemoDB; CREATE TABLE Employees (Id INT PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY, Name NVARCHAR(100), Department NVARCHAR(50), Salary DECIMAL(10,2), HireDate DATE); INSERT INTO Employees VALUES ('Alice Smith','Engineering',95000,'2019-03-15'),('Bob Jones','Sales',72000,'2020-07-01'),('Carol Wu','HR',68000,'2021-01-10'),('David Park','Engineering',105000,'2018-11-22'),('Eve Torres','Finance',88000,'2017-05-30'); CREATE TABLE Products (Id INT PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY, Name NVARCHAR(100), Category NVARCHAR(50), Price DECIMAL(10,2), Stock INT); INSERT INTO Products VALUES ('Laptop Pro','Electronics',1299.99,45),('Office Chair','Furniture',449.00,120),('Standing Desk','Furniture',699.00,35),('Wireless Mouse','Electronics',49.99,200),('Monitor 4K','Electronics',599.99,60);" \
      2>/dev/null || true

  # Wait for Cassandra then create keyspace
  - sleep 120
  - |
    docker exec demo-cassandra cqlsh -e "
      CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS demodb WITH replication = {'class':'SimpleStrategy','replication_factor':1};
      USE demodb;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT, salary DECIMAL, hire_date DATE);
      INSERT INTO employees (id, name, department, salary, hire_date) VALUES (uuid(), 'Alice Smith', 'Engineering', 95000, '2019-03-15');
      INSERT INTO employees (id, name, department, salary, hire_date) VALUES (uuid(), 'Bob Jones', 'Sales', 72000, '2020-07-01');
      INSERT INTO employees (id, name, department, salary, hire_date) VALUES (uuid(), 'Carol Wu', 'HR', 68000, '2021-01-10');
    " 2>/dev/null || true

  # Signal ready
  - echo "DEMO_READY=$(date)" >> /etc/environment
  - echo "All demo databases started" > /opt/demo-dbs/READY

write_files:
  - path: /opt/demo-dbs/seed/postgresql/01-init.sql
    content: |
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        department VARCHAR(50),
        salary NUMERIC(10,2),
        hire_date DATE
      );
      INSERT INTO employees (name, department, salary, hire_date) VALUES
        ('Alice Smith',  'Engineering', 95000, '2019-03-15'),
        ('Bob Jones',    'Sales',       72000, '2020-07-01'),
        ('Carol Wu',     'HR',          68000, '2021-01-10'),
        ('David Park',   'Engineering', 105000,'2018-11-22'),
        ('Eve Torres',   'Finance',     88000, '2017-05-30');

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
        id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        category VARCHAR(50),
        price NUMERIC(10,2),
        stock INTEGER
      );
      INSERT INTO products (name, category, price, stock) VALUES
        ('Laptop Pro',    'Electronics', 1299.99, 45),
        ('Office Chair',  'Furniture',    449.00, 120),
        ('Standing Desk', 'Furniture',    699.00,  35),
        ('Wireless Mouse','Electronics',   49.99, 200),
        ('Monitor 4K',    'Electronics',  599.99,  60);

      CREATE VIEW v_engineering_team AS
        SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering';

      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_employees_by_dept(dept VARCHAR)
      RETURNS TABLE(id INT, name VARCHAR, salary NUMERIC) AS $$
        SELECT id, name, salary FROM employees WHERE department = dept;
      $$ LANGUAGE SQL;

  - path: /opt/demo-dbs/seed/mysql/01-init.sql
    content: |
      USE demodb;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        department VARCHAR(50),
        salary DECIMAL(10,2),
        hire_date DATE,
        INDEX idx_dept (department)
      );
      INSERT INTO employees (name, department, salary, hire_date) VALUES
        ('Alice Smith',  'Engineering', 95000, '2019-03-15'),
        ('Bob Jones',    'Sales',       72000, '2020-07-01'),
        ('Carol Wu',     'HR',          68000, '2021-01-10'),
        ('David Park',   'Engineering', 105000,'2018-11-22'),
        ('Eve Torres',   'Finance',     88000, '2017-05-30');

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        employee_id INT,
        product_name VARCHAR(100),
        amount DECIMAL(10,2),
        order_date DATETIME DEFAULT NOW(),
        FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(id)
      );
      INSERT INTO orders (employee_id, product_name, amount) VALUES
        (1, 'Laptop Pro', 1299.99),
        (2, 'Office Chair', 449.00),
        (3, 'Wireless Mouse', 49.99);

      DELIMITER //
      CREATE PROCEDURE IF NOT EXISTS GetEmployeesByDept(IN dept VARCHAR(50))
      BEGIN
        SELECT * FROM employees WHERE department = dept;
      END //
      DELIMITER ;

  - path: /opt/demo-dbs/seed/mariadb/01-init.sql
    content: |
      USE demodb;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        email VARCHAR(150) UNIQUE,
        country VARCHAR(50),
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT NOW()
      );
      INSERT INTO customers (name, email, country) VALUES
        ('Acme Corp',      'contact@acme.com',    'USA'),
        ('Globex Inc',     'info@globex.com',     'Germany'),
        ('Initech Ltd',    'hello@initech.com',   'UK'),
        ('Umbrella Corp',  'sales@umbrella.com',  'Japan'),
        ('Soylent Corp',   'info@soylent.com',    'France');

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
        id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
        customer_id INT,
        amount DECIMAL(10,2),
        status ENUM('pending','paid','overdue') DEFAULT 'pending',
        due_date DATE,
        FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id)
      );
      INSERT INTO invoices (customer_id, amount, status, due_date) VALUES
        (1, 5000.00, 'paid',    '2026-06-01'),
        (2, 12500.00,'pending', '2026-08-15'),
        (3, 3200.00, 'overdue', '2026-05-01'),
        (4, 8900.00, 'paid',    '2026-07-01'),
        (5, 1500.00, 'pending', '2026-09-01');

  - path: /opt/demo-dbs/seed/mongodb/01-init.js
    content: |
      db = db.getSiblingDB('demodb');
      db.employees.insertMany([
        { name: 'Alice Smith',  department: 'Engineering', salary: 95000, hireDate: new Date('2019-03-15'), skills: ['Python','Azure','Docker'] },
        { name: 'Bob Jones',    department: 'Sales',       salary: 72000, hireDate: new Date('2020-07-01'), skills: ['CRM','Excel'] },
        { name: 'Carol Wu',     department: 'HR',          salary: 68000, hireDate: new Date('2021-01-10'), skills: ['Recruiting','HR Systems'] },
        { name: 'David Park',   department: 'Engineering', salary: 105000,hireDate: new Date('2018-11-22'), skills: ['Kubernetes','Go','Terraform'] },
        { name: 'Eve Torres',   department: 'Finance',     salary: 88000, hireDate: new Date('2017-05-30'), skills: ['SAP','Excel','PowerBI'] }
      ]);
      db.products.insertMany([
        { name: 'Laptop Pro',    category: 'Electronics', price: 1299.99, stock: 45,  tags: ['portable','high-performance'] },
        { name: 'Office Chair',  category: 'Furniture',   price: 449.00,  stock: 120, tags: ['ergonomic','adjustable'] },
        { name: 'Standing Desk', category: 'Furniture',   price: 699.00,  stock: 35,  tags: ['height-adjustable','large'] },
        { name: 'Wireless Mouse',category: 'Electronics', price: 49.99,   stock: 200, tags: ['wireless','compact'] },
        { name: 'Monitor 4K',    category: 'Electronics', price: 599.99,  stock: 60,  tags: ['4k','27inch','hdr'] }
      ]);
      db.employees.createIndex({ department: 1 });
      db.products.createIndex({ category: 1 });
      print('MongoDB seed data inserted');
